If you haven't changed the default password on your home router, you may be in for an unwanted visit from Chuck Norris -- the Chuck Norris botnet, that is. Discovered by Czech researchers, the botnet has been spreading by taking advantage of poorly configured routers and DSL modems.

British authorities have had 30 Facebook pages taken down because prisoners were using them to taunt their victims, including the family of a 10-year-old who was murdered. Justice Secretary Jack Straw said he was "reassured by the co-operation which we're receiving from Facebook" and said it was agreed a better system for policing sites was needed.
